dedupe_keys.name: table of amateur radio voice repeaters and relays in greece ministry list published by targ

description: This six-page PDF is the table of amateur radio voice repeaters and relays in Greece attached to letter 16599/622 of 6 April 2010 of the Ministry of Infrastructure, Transport and Networks, as published by the TARG amateur radio group. For each repeater or relay it gives a serial number, the call sign, whether it is a voice repeater or a voice relay, the transmit and receive frequencies, the channel spacing (12.5 or 25 kHz), the access subtone, the site, the prefecture and the responsible amateur radio association; the first entries include a 145.625 MHz repeater on Mount Parnitha in Attica and 430 MHz relays in Trikala and Laconia. Access is free online; no licence is stated in the document. Caveats: the list dates from 2010, so frequencies, sites and operators may have changed, and the table is in Greek. Coverage is Greece. It supports emergency response planning that uses amateur radio as backup communication when public networks fail; related records are the Norwegian repeater list and the French amateur repeaters and beacons list.
